'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come on in. As a hunter, I can tell you for sure that holding control over the target is really important. Sometimes if you manage to blind the animal, even the most dangerous one, it stops being dangerous to you. This works with humans as well. Who cares how pimped out their guns are if they're as blind as moles? I want you to show me if you're able to properly blind your enemy.}}

==Objectives==

*Eliminate 2 PMCs while they are suffering from the stun effect

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* 1× [[NcSTAR ADO P4 Sniper 3-9x42 riflescope]]
* 1× [[7.62x51mm M80 ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle]] (variant AICS) at [[Jaeger]] LL3
{{quote|Learned the lesson? Good. See, you can disarm an enemy in many ways.}}

==Guide==
You can use the [[Model 7290 Flash Bang grenade|M7290 grenade]], the [[Zarya stun grenade|Zarya grenade]] or a [[KS-23M]] with the [[23x75mm Zvezda flashbang round|Zvezda flashbang round]] to cause the stun effect for this quest. [[Factory]] is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at close distance, thus reducing their chance to escape the stun effect.
